==Skin Upgrades==
The '''Saboteur''' has two skins in total. This includes:
#The Default skin.
#One skin that can be obtained from [[Crates]].

{{Tabber
|Default
|{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = Default
|Icon1 = [[File:DefaultSaboteurIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:DefaultSaboteur0.png|200px]]
|Pale skin, greenish-grey lab coat, grey gas mask, grey pouch, brown jumpsuit and maroon shoes.

Wields a triple-barrel toxic shotgun to attack enemies.
|[[File:DefaultSaboteur1.png|200px]]
|Brown gloves with claws and a pocket knife.
|[[File:DefaultSaboteur2.png|200px]]
|Black shoulder-pads, brown pouches and glowing green tubes on belt and lab coat now has two belts.

Gas mask now has two cartridges.
|[[File:DefaultSaboteur3.png|200px]]
|Grey backpack with toxic canister strapped on it.

Now can throw a glowstick grenade.
|[[File:DefaultSaboteur4.png|200px]]
|Lab coat, claws, pocket knife and backpack are now bright green.

Now wields a upgraded triple-barrel toxic shotgun.
}}
|Coral Princess
|The {{Color|Beach|Coral Princess}} skin can be obtained from the [[Beach Crate|{{Color|Beach|Beach Crate}}]].
{{SkinGallery
|Title1 = {{Color|Beach|Coral Princess}}
|Icon1 = [[File:CoralPrincessSaboteurIconIG.png|128px]]
|[[File:CoralPrincessSaboteur0.png|200px]]
|Pink skin, pink hair, white and pink dress and pants.

Wields a coral gun to attack enemies.
|[[File:CoralPrincessSaboteur1.png|200px]]
|Pink mask on face.
|[[File:CoralPrincessSaboteur2.png|200px]]
|Pink circles on chest and arms.
|[[File:CoralPrincessSaboteur3.png|200px]]
|Longer dress and a second hood.

Small pink part on its back with a crack showing a pearl in darkness.
|[[File:CoralPrincessSaboteur4.png|200px]]
|Pearls on hoods,

Pearl on the back now bursts out of it and floats in the air.

Coral gun is now darker.
}}
}}
